Die derzeitige regionale Umsatzbasis liegt bei rund 3 Millionen US-Dollar pro Jahr, wobei ein aggressives Wachstum gegenüber dem Vorjahr das Hauptziel ist. Die Rolle ist Teil eines übergeordneten Project-Leadership-Teams und arbeitet eng mit den Verantwortlichen der Geschäftsbereiche Whitespace, ICT und PjM zusammen, um die regionale Wirkung zu maximieren.

Der Standort der Position ist Frankfurt am Main, wobei regelmäßige Reisen innerhalb von DACH und CEE sowie gelegentliche Einsätze außerhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten bei kritischen Wartungs- und Umsetzungsfenstern erforderlich sind.

Hauptaufgabenbereich:

  • Eigentümerschaft und Ausbau der regionalen P&L (GuV) durch Pipeline-Entwicklung, Kundenkonvertierung und Neugeschäftsgewinnung; Vertrieb von Services zur Erzielung eines aggressiven Umsatzwachstums gegenüber dem Vorjahr.
  • Leitung der sicheren, termingerechten und margenkonformen Abwicklung von Investitions- und Modernisierungsprojekten (Capital Asset Upgrade & Replacement) in DACH und CEE unter Einhaltung einheitlicher Governance-, Abwicklungsstandards und Performance-Metriken.
  • Aufbau und Konvertierung einer Vertriebs-Pipeline für die nächsten 12 bis 24 Monate über ein etabliertes Netzwerk aus Rechenzentren-Kunden, Investoren und Colocation-Betreibern; federführende Betreuung aller Angebote, Ausschreibungen und Proposal-Prozesse.
  • Anwendung branchenspezifischer Beschaffungsstrategien (einschließlich wettbewerblicher Ausschreibungen, Lieferantenauswahl und Back-to-Back-Nachunternehmerstrukturen) sowie Sicherstellung der kaufmännischen Compliance nach FIDIC und anderen relevanten Vertragsstandards.
  • Rekrutierung, Coaching, Mentoring und Weiterentwicklung eines hochperformativen Teams aus Senior Project Managern, Project Managern und Project Support Professionals; Steuerung der Personal- und Nachfolgeplanung.
  • Repräsentanz von CBRE als souveräne und glaubwürdige Führungspersönlichkeit – mit ebenso überzeugendem Auftreten gegenüber potenziellen Kunden und Branchenforen wie gegenüber internen Site-Operations-Teams.
  • Enge Partnerschaft mit internen CBRE-Führungskräften aus QHSE, Finance, Commercial, Sales, Procurement, Account, Technical und Operations zur Ausrichtung der Projektabwicklung an regionalen Unternehmenszielen; dabei werden interne Operation-Teams als geschätzte Kunden-Stakeholder behandelt.
  • Sicherstellung, dass die Projektverwaltung im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich jederzeit „audit-ready“ (prüfungsbereit) ist. Dies erfordert ein tiefes Verständnis der Abwicklungsprozesse und IT-Tools, damit allen Teammitgliedern ihre Ziele klar sind.
  • Kontinuierliche Identifikation von Verbesserungspotenzialen zur Optimierung von Best Business Practices.

Cold calling is the heart of this role, and most of our meetings get booked over the phone - not because it's easy, but because it's still the fastest way to build real trust with a prospect. We don't copy-paste templates, and we don't spam: every call and every piece of outreach is backed by careful research and planning alongside the AEs you partner with, so the person on the other end knows you're not a random dial.

We're founded by engineers, and that shows up in how BDRs work too, everyone gets unlimited Claude tokens, and our head of business development is a former RevOps leader himself, so there's a real emphasis on testing, measuring, and optimizing your own workflow like an engineer would, not just running the same script on repeat.

BDRs are the bench for our wider GTM team, and your progress here matters beyond just you, it's how we keep the whole GTM engine strong. The path to AE is real, and for those who put in the work, that next step can come faster than you'd expect elsewhere - with the strength of the peer group you're learning from making all the difference.

Who you are

  • You've got a strong why. Whatever got you here - sport, a career switch, a BDR track record that deserved the promotion you didn't get last time, you know exactly what you're chasing, and that's what gets you through the hard days.

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

Director of Sales, ITS, Europe

Who is Seyond? 

 
Seyond is a leading global provider of image-grade LiDAR technology, powering a safer, smarter and more mobile world across the automotive, intelligent transportation, robotics and industrial automation sectors. Founded in Silicon Valley with strategically placed research and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Seyond is crafting LiDAR solutions that elevate autonomous driving and fuel the advancement of smart infrastructure development. Our dynamic portfolio – including ultra-long range flagship LiDAR sensor Falcon, mid-to-short range LiDAR sensor Robin and perception service software platform OmniVidi – powers automotive and ITS solutions for partners like NIO, Faraday Future, Exwayz and Hexagon. Currently, over 200,000 Falcon units are in use, and the product continues to be mass-produced today. 

 

Senior Director of Sales, Europe

SIMPL Business Unit — Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)

Seyond

Location: Germany preferred (open to strong candidates elsewhere in Europe)

Reports to: Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business (ex-US/China)

Team: SIMPL Business Unit — LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection

Employment type: Full-time

About Seyond SIMPL

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will report directly to Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business, and will sit above SIMPL's country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead SIMPL's European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.
  • Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection.
  • Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers.
  • Own the European sales pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, maintaining accurate deal ownership, stage progression, and close-date discipline.
  • Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings.

  • Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.
  • A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine "hunter," not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.

  • Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.
  • Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.
  • Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Nice to Have

  • An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.
  • Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

Compensation

Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.
